name: Witch of the Moors
oracle_text:
Deathtouch
At the beginning of your end step, if you gained life this turn, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice and you return up to one target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your end step, if you gained life this turn, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice and you return up to one target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

needs.what: a per-player turn tally of life gained (value `life_gained_this_turn` with a player, or a condition `gained_life_this_turn`), recorded by the engine on every life_gained event regardless of whether the source was on the battlefield, reset at cleanup, usable as an intervening-if trigger condition on an end_step trigger
needs.why_existing_wont_do: value_keys has life_lost_this_turn, damage_taken_this_turn and cards_drawn_this_turn but no life-gained counterpart, and no engine code tracks life gained per turn; has_turn_flag would need an unprinted you_gain_life trigger to set the flag, which misses life gained before this creature entered and adds an ability that claims no printed line
